column1: # RV shop term families for the page-finder's word half (pagefinder/terms.py). Hand-maintained; one row per family.
# Columns (TAB separated): kind <TAB> members separated by " | " <TAB> evidence (where the library or the cases use these words)
#   same   = spelling / shop abbreviation of ONE word: every member is rewritten to the FIRST member, in pages and queries.
#   family = words a tech and a manual use for the same thing. Query side only: when one member is in the query, the other
#            members' words are added at FAMILY_WEIGHT (0.5), so pages with the tech's exact words still rank first.
#            A member is a phrase; its words must appear in order in the query (a few words apart is fine).
#            'not' stands for any negation (not, no, never, won't, doesn't ...): 'not cold' matches "will not blow cold".
#   keep   = words the GENERATED tables (word_forms.tsv, compounds.tsv, acronyms.tsv) must leave alone, because the
#            generated base form means something else in the bay (fitting is not fit, housing is not house).
# Rules for adding a row: every member must be a word the library's manuals or the real case files use (cite one);
# no brand or model names; no case-specific phrases.
